text: Zainab Khalil worked as a Software Engineer Intern at AICE XPERT from January 2026 to April 2026. She expanded a live B2B SaaS platform to 5,000+ professionals by shipping full-stack features on a Next.js/Express/Supabase stack, including card management, QR customisation, and NFC integration. She built a live phone-preview component with instant QR rendering supporting 20+ dot shapes, gradient fills, and custom logos, eliminating third-party QR tool dependencies. She shipped a cross-platform analytics pipeline tracking card taps, geo-location, device breakdowns, and link clicks to inform premium upsell strategy. She also engineered 10+ RESTful API endpoints enabling dynamic data flow between frontend and backend within a 4-member Agile team.

Zainab Khalil interned as a Software Engineering Intern at INFOTECH from July 2025 to August 2025. She architected 5+ microservices using Spring Boot, applying SOLID principles and clean architecture. She implemented service discovery via Netflix Eureka across distributed services for dynamic routing and fault-tolerant communication. She also centralized routing via an API Gateway, consolidating 10+ endpoints and improving system observability, security, and traceability.

ResuFlow is an AI-Powered CV-to-Portfolio Pipeline built by Zainab Khalil using React, Node.js, MongoDB, and the Gemini API. It is an end-to-end pipeline that transforms unstructured CV data into deployed portfolio websites via AI-driven extraction. The Gemini API converts free-form text into validated JSON schemas. Deployment is automated via Vercel APIs with integrated QR code generation (Level H error correction) for one-click hosting and sharing.

Zainab Khalil developed an Android Housing Service App using Java, Firebase, and Cloudinary. It is a full-stack Android application supporting tenant and landlord workflows with authentication and real-time sync. It manages 100+ property listings via Firebase Realtime Database and integrates AI-based recommendations for improved property discovery.

Zainab Khalil built a Mood-Based Music Recommendation System using Node.js, SQL Server, and the Spotify API. It is a backend-driven system mapping user mood inputs to dynamically generated Spotify playlists with 10+ songs per session. The system uses a normalized relational schema spanning 10+ tables for efficient storage and retrieval of user and playlist data.

Zainab Khalil's technical skills include: Languages: C++, Java, JavaScript, Assembly (x86). Frameworks: React, Next.js, Node.js, Spring Boot, Android (Java). Databases: SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase Realtime Database. Core Concepts: Data Structures & Algorithms, OOP, System Design, Microservices Architecture. Tools: Git, Postman, REST APIs, Gemini API, Spotify API, Cloudinary, Netflix Eureka, Vercel.
